title: [DRAFTING] Kabocha X Mahogany live immersive (funding) music experiences
body:
This post is being updated (DRAFT) _tagline: The first funding proposal from Placeholder Labs (PH Labs). Live and digital immersive experiences with blockchain for creative and music artists._ Project Code | Date | NSP | Authors | Contributors | Status | | ----------------- | ----- | -----------------------------------------| --------- |-------------------- | --------- | | #PHLABS-DEECE-001-P01 | 15th June 2022 | Ramsey(Decentration) | Ramsey(Decentration), Mark(Mahogany), Beej(New-Futures) | [Mahogany](https://www.youtube.com/c/MahoganySessions/), [New-Futures](https://new-futures.co), [Decentration](https://decentration.org/) | _(Draft / Updating)_ | _Note: Ramsey(Decentration) is not funded in this proposal_ # Summary The first experiment from Placeholder Labs, to deliver live immersive music experience powered by Kabocha (web3), creative technologies and music production. The world's future artists can be come through Kabocha, with funding and their interaction with fans. **tl;dr**
Think Secret Cinema, VR Van Gogh, and You Me Bum Bum Train powered by Web3 (Edgeware and Kabocha). ## What is PH Labs? Placeholder Labs is the creative collective of three companies that together are focused on building immersive and innovative music events that layer real-world experiences with Web3 technologies that create once-in-a-lifetime experiences for participants. We are registered as a DOrg on Edgeware and Kabocha, part of the Edgeware community and have been working on project plans which will some funding to build out utility for the music industry on Kabocha. We will be doing this through a series of experiments that will test out: - event ticketing and memorabilia collectibles, - grant funding, - cultural collateral, - blockchain funded started investment, - IP ownership royalties, - fractional ownership, commissioning artists, - music DAO collectives (DOrgs) showing how they can work as a template to future projects from other members of Edgeware a
